summary: Steep residential kerb at 15% grade with homes 10-16 m away.
reasons: Houses and flats close all round

drivers.seclusion: Houses 11-16 m away on its own side and unit blocks across the road; no screening.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street, cars parked on the west side; room on the east kerb is tight on a steep fall.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street leading to a junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the street; signed 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Dwellings within 10-16 m on its own side
Signed 2P daytime weekdays, resident permits excepted
sun_shade: Trees at the lower end shade the kerb; upper part open to the sun.

best_section.where: East kerb of Moorak Street, mid-block above the Marmion Parade corner
